data: Which line represents the Swahili (MLing + BAB300) model in the "Full Network Adaptation" graph?

The legend indicates the models as follows:

- Blue line: Kurmanji (MLing + SWBD)
- Yellow line: Swahili (MLing + SWBD)
- Purple line: Kurmanji (MLing + BAB300)

In the "Full Network Adaptation" graph, the red line corresponds to the Swahili (MLing + BAB300) model. Therefore, the line representing the Swahili (MLing + BAB300) model is the red line.
